research_notes: The eventual system can use a two-level policy: a validated hard runtime cap plus a task-admission rule that decides whether residual budget is usable.
This is cleaner than embedding every workload detail into the scheduler itself.
Scheduler responsibility remains simply securing continuation early.
Work-admission responsibility remains local to the active invocation.
Separating those concerns reduces control coupling and scheduler race risk.
The current experiment already uses that separation structurally.
